entries.name: 비 내리는 바다
entries.prompt: Create a single full bleed portrait 9:16 aquarium game underwater background, soft polished painterly illustration. Elegant minimal composition with at least 80% open calm water negative space for moving fish. Seabed low at bottom, only tiny corner accents. No animals, fish, UI, text, bubbles, ornate objects, ruins or busy detail. Strong distinct theme expressed through lighting, water and seabed rather than decorations. Underwater view during gentle rain, subdued slate blue and gray teal water, surface at very top with small concentric rain ripples, soft overcast diffuse light, smooth gray sand and one small pebble. Peaceful rainy day, not stormy.
